entities.name: PMID:27500213
observations: 2015 Transplantation Direct study tested CHBP in preservation/autologous blood perfusate in isolated porcine kidneys.
Kidneys underwent 20-minute warm ischemia, 18-hour cold storage, and 3-hour normothermic hemoreperfusion; n=5, group allocation unclear in abstract.

CHBP at 10.56 nmol/L increased renal blood flow, oxygen consumption, urine output; reduced potassium, tissue damage, tubular apoptosis, MPO-positive cells, and caspase-3; increased HSP70. Abstract supplied no effect sizes.
